research.title: Evidence Sensitivity in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Designed experiments varying passage relevance, ordering, and distractor content to assess evidence dependence in retrieval-augmented question answering.
Analyzed answer correctness and supporting passage attribution, distinguishing retrieval failures from generation errors through controlled perturbations and manual error review.

research.title: Negation and Lexical Overlap in Natural Language Inference
bullets: Designed matched evaluation sets manipulating negation placement and lexical overlap to examine shortcut behavior in natural language inference models.
Compared prediction changes across original and perturbed sentence pairs, analyzing error patterns by inference label and syntactic construction.

research.title: Domain Shift and Confidence Calibration in Support Request Classification
bullets: Designed cross-domain experiments comparing sparse lexical classifiers and pretrained text encoders for support request classification under changing vocabulary and label distributions.
Analyzed calibration, selective prediction, and classwise errors using held-out domains, separating effects of terminology changes from differences in category prevalence.

work.title: Text Intake Validation and Search Maintenance
bullets: Implemented input validation and text normalization for document intake, adding regression tests for malformed records, encoding issues, and duplicate submissions.
Maintained keyword search components, investigated indexing discrepancies, and corrected document update handling to keep retrieved records consistent with stored content.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Named Entity Recognition Models
bullets: Implemented a conditional random field baseline and fine-tuned a pretrained token classifier for named entity recognition using consistent dataset splits.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, examining boundary errors, rare entity types, and sensitivity to tokenization differences through manually reviewed predictions.

projects.title: Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Passage Search
bullets: Implemented probabilistic sparse retrieval and dense passage retrieval pipelines with shared document preprocessing and evaluation queries to support a controlled comparison.
Evaluated ranking quality and inspected retrieval disagreements, categorizing failures involving synonymy, exact phrase matching, and ambiguous query terms.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Graph Ranking and Sentence Embeddings
bullets: Implemented graph-based sentence ranking and embedding-based sentence selection for extractive summarization, applying identical preprocessing and summary length constraints.
Compared summaries using reference overlap and manual content checks, analyzing redundancy, missing salient information, and dependence on sentence position.
